description: Reject a pathological event series whose high-order spline derivative becomes non-positive inside the valid output domain.

expected_error.description: The canonical order-14 spline derivative is non-positive on this strongly alternating interval sequence and must not be clamped or returned as a physiological rate.

oracle.description: The input is finite and strictly increasing, but canonical high-order interpolation overshoots and produces a negative derivative within [0, 1.01]. Positivity is a normative postcondition, so the required outcome is invalid_numerical_result rather than a numerical vector.
